facts: Parties: Ingleby Analytics Ltd (Buyer), Brightwater Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Calloway Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 21 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 20 May 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,025,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $3,000,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,880,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $203,760,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,200,000.
